units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:10">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:11">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="S00864"><he>קִיבָר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:6">Ḥall. I, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01040"><he>חֲלִיטָה</he> II</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:17">Ab. III, 17</cite> <he>אם אין ק׳ אין … אין ק׳</he> without flour (sustenance) no learning, without learning no flour (enjoyment of life).—Pl. <he>קְמָחִים</he>, <he>קְמָחִין</he>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 53a:4">Kidd. 53ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 73a:3">Men. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>הללו … והללו מיני ק׳</he> these (the animal sacrifices) are blood offerings, those (the cakes &c.) are flour offerings.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:1:14">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵇ</cite> <he>תבואה ק׳ ובציקות</he> grains, flours, and doughs; a. e.

senses.gloss: (from its color) mould gathered on wine.—Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:7">Men. VIII, 7</cite> <he>אינו … מפני הק׳</he> one must not take for libation from the top of the cask on account of the mould.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:7">Ib.</cite> <he>יין … ק׳ פסול</he> wine on which mould is gathered is unfit for the altar.
